mechanism: Pair A one black square with C two rotated black squares using matching open two-edge corners. Targets counting same-shape black components and ignoring scale, inferring C exceeds A. No option letter or whole panel is highlighted.
mathematical_solution: Normalize each panel side to 2. A has one 1x1 black square of area 1; B has two right triangles of legs 1, total 1; C has two diamonds with perpendicular diagonals 1 and 1, each area 1/2, total 1; D has four triangles of base 1 and height 1/2, each area 1/4, total 1. All black areas are exactly one quarter of the same-sized panel, uniquely E. Existing black fill and all original subdivision edges remain visible.
